objective: Compose the canonical bounded recent-relationship CRM cohort with the reusable multi-dimension acquisition snapshot so one application call can produce several acquisition economics breakdowns over the same recent CRM population.
cohortMeaning: Most recently updated CRM relationships using the canonical CRM list ordering and bounds.
rules: Do not duplicate CRM relationship SQL inside insurance analytics.
Omitting limit preserves CRM ownership of its default limit.
Returned CRM relationship IDs are canonically validated before snapshot execution.
Relationship ordering from the canonical CRM list is preserved.
The snapshot application is invoked exactly once per request.
All requested dimensions are evaluated by INS-003M over one reusable attributed economics view load.
No cohort, view, aggregate, or snapshot result is persisted.
